text:
mia: Heads-up — ran the new quantized bring-up for rdx-ql-2b-q4 on CI and the dashboard shows a huge spike in regressions across multiple eval suites. Individual test runs look normal though. Anyone seen this pattern?

samir: hmm. seen similar when the eval-runner normalized metric keys. can you paste the exact dashboard diff? :eyes:

mia: pasted snapshot link: https://redwood.internal/dash/rdx-ql-2b-q4/diff/176200 — top-level shows +12% regression in "overall_quality". drilling down the top tests shows small diffs ~0.5% or none.

eva: could be aggregation mismatch — dashboard expects per-case "em_pct" but runner exports "exact_match_pct" for some suites. UI code maps either key, but only at display time. if the aggregator saw mixed keys it may have computed a wrong mean.

samir: yep that's my money. also saw a bug in the runner where metrics with underscores and aliases get deduped incorrectly. quick grep:

```
# result normalization
metric_key = k.replace("%", "pct").lower()
# later
if metric_key in seen: continue  # -> can drop alias'd metrics
```

this drops metrics unpredictably.

luis: CI logs show a few WARNs at the same time: "WARNING: metric 'accuracy' computed with zero denom, returning NaN". NaNs end up as zeros in the aggregator and skew the mean. attaching tail of the job log: see lines ~540-548.

ci-bot: build 42987 for rdx-ql-2b-q4-quant passed with warnings — https://ci.redwood/jobs/42987 (flaky-evals flagged)

ara: additionally the quantized runner triggers slightly different tokenization for a couple benchmarks (truncation differences), so per-example distributions shift. if the dashboard only shows a single mean + delta it can look like a broad regression. we need distribution plots.

mia: ok so multiple contributing factors: key aliasing drop, NaN->zero in aggregator, and tokenization diffs for a subset. priority fix?

samir: fix runner normalization first (very small PR). I'll standardize metric_key mapping and ensure aliases merge instead of drop. patch: replace the dedupe logic with a merge that keeps both names mapped to canonical key.

samir: also add a validation step in CI that fails the job if any metric is NaN instead of letting aggregator coerce it. quick patch I can open.

eva: from dashboard side I'll add an optional "raw distribution" panel and a drilldown link for the top N failing tests so SREs can click into per-case diffs. also we'll show raw metric keys in the hover so we can spot aliasing.

luis: i'll add a CI gate that checks tokenization parity for the quantized build against the baseline for a sampled subset — fail the canary if >1% examples differ. this will at least catch those truncation shifts early.

ara: tiny note: for long term we should prefer per-metric aggregates (median + IQR) in the scorecards rather than mean, to be robust to NaNs and outliers.

mia: assigning owners: samir -> runner normalization + NaN CI check, eva -> dashboard distribution + key hover, luis -> tokenization parity gate. Can we get PRs by EOD Fri?

samir: i'll open draft PR 5824 for the runner fix today, ETA Thu for final.

eva: draft UI changes as prototype mock attached in figma, i'll link in the ticket. ETA Fri for initial rollout behind feature flag.

luis: tokenization gate ticket created TKT-1187, will land Monday.

mia: thanks all. for now I'll mark the dashboard regression as "investigating" and mute alerting on that dashboard until fixes land. please ping here when PRs land so I can re-run the quantized bring-up. :thumbsup:

samir: one more — for the CI wiring, make sure the dashboard ingestion uses the raw JSON from the job artifacts rather than the aggregated blob the runner posts. that avoids double-aggregation.

ara: noted. also adding a short test to the eval harness that simulates aliased keys + NaNs to prevent regression.

mia: perfect. tagging @samir @eva @luis for follow-up.

ci-bot: note: next scheduled run for rdx-ql-2b-q4-quant at 1762080000 UTC.

mia: closing loop here but leaving thread open for updates.
